verses.en: (O Prophet,) When there comes Allah’s help and the Victory,

verses.ar: وَرَاَيۡتَ النَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ فِيۡ دِيۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَفۡوَاجًاۙ‏
verses.en: and you see people entering Allah’s (approved) religion in multitudes,

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُؕؔ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ تَوَّابًاࣖ‏
verses.en: then pronounce the purity and praise of your Lord, and seek forgiveness from Him. Surely He is Ever-Relenting.
